items.title: SimPanel minor 2: the picker reads its first scenario at draw time; audit every Sim-1.0 read of d.scenarios for snapshots taken at New (DW-04 library gap)
items.spec: ADDITIVE library fix for a LibKa0s-Sim-1.0 contract gap that DW-04 found (OWNER_SCOPE B; RESUME section 5). GAP: LibKa0s/SimPanel.lua (SIM_PANEL_MINOR 1) reads `ctx.d.scenarios.names[1]` once, in lib.__AttachPanel inside Sim:New (`choice = { scenario = first, size = 0 }`). A host that fills d.scenarios after New, which LK-26 (Sim minor 2) made legal, gets a nil choice for good. PanelRows() idle then gives { 'Start: nil', 'Stop simulation' }, and the picker's Start runs `start nil`. FIX: add `local function chosen(P)`, which returns P.choice.scenario when defOf(P, it) resolves and otherwise ctx.d.scenarios.names[1] read live. Use it everywhere P.choice.scenario is read: model's idle branch, act's Start, the picker's typed() and Start onClick, and paintPicker's SelectValue and def lookup. __AttachPanel keeps `first` as the initial value but allows nil. SIM_PANEL_MINOR 1 -> 2, paired on the shell, with the Sim docs key, version doc and members manifest (`lua tools/gen-api-members.lua`; previous marked Superseded with 'Moving to'), docs/api/README row, the CHANGELOG `## v1.75.0` block (not public yet; the tag is local), docs/test-cases.md and README majors rows if they name the minor. Test first (watch it fail for the right reason): New with scenarios={names={},defs={}}, then fill names/defs in place; PanelRows()[1].label == 'Start: <first def label>' with the preview step rows present; clicking the picker's Start starts the first scenario. AUDIT (mandatory, so no third gap surfaces in LH-10/BL-08): grep Sim.lua, SimPanel.lua, SimTimeline.lua, SimVerbs and any other Sim*.lua for any value derived from d.scenarios, d.panel, d.L, d.verbs/usage/why/statusLine or other descriptor tables that is captured at New rather than read at use. Fix each one the same additive way, with a failing case each, or list it in the commit body as deliberately New-time with the reason. Also check that a descriptor table filled in place after New (DropWatcher fills scenarios, verbs, usage and why after New) works for every documented field. No new public member. Gate: lua tests/run.lua through ka0s-bounded, luacheck 0/0, test_versioning green, 1500-line cap. Do NOT move or create the tag; the lead re-gates and moves it.
